description: This Java class 'MerchantConfigurationDaoImpl' is an implementation of the data access object (DAO) for managing 'MerchantConfiguration' entities. It provides methods to retrieve merchant configuration data from the database using QueryDSL with JPA, such as fetching configurations by key, store, and type.

classes.name: MerchantConfigurationDaoImpl
classes.description: Implementation of DAO for 'MerchantConfiguration', extending generic DAO and providing specific queries.

methods.name: getMerchantConfiguration
methods.description: Fetches a single MerchantConfiguration by key and store.

methods.name: getMerchantConfigurations
methods.description: Retrieves all MerchantConfiguration entries for a given store.

methods.name: listByType
methods.description: Lists MerchantConfiguration entries filtered by configuration type and store.
